main.description: Dissolve an organism pattern. Sets dissolved_at on vertex_organism_pattern and freezes the DID's ability to emit new karma edges. Existing edges persist in network unchanged (Karma.lean N2 edge_outlives_endpoint). The new organism (if any) cannot claim continuity (Karma.lean anatman_unique_santana). Symmetric across individual / collective organisms (no kind discrimination).

dissolutionKind.description: Symmetric for individual (death / voluntary seal / rebirth) and collective (legal dissolution / merger). 'judgment-forced' = 餓鬼道 forced seal by 覚者 DAO.

membershipDepsRootCid.description: IPFS CID of the snapshot of all cohorts/contexts the organism participated in. Persists with edge graph as historical record.

rationaleCid.description: Optional encrypted rationale (Vault Zero-Knowledge Invariant — server never holds plaintext).
